def fit(cols,names):

    c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dP_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    r=dP_dt-X@c

    return r

def equation(t, P, params):

def equation(t, P, params):
    a,b,c,d,e,f,g,h = params[0],params[1],params[2],params[3],params[4],params[5],params[6],params[7]
